snippet.title: Stellar Freight: Endless Horizon - Game Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
• Wishlist on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4249000/Stellar_Freight_Endless_Horizon?utm_source=twocakesstudio&utm_campaign=youtube&utm_medium=page_release
• Embark on a Sci-fi Roguelike Turn-based RPG with Tactical combat. Take command of a freight ship, travel through deep space, manage your crew, upgrade your ship, trade loot, fight pirates, and build your reputation. Every jump brings danger or treasure, but space doesn’t forgive mistakes.

#indiegame #gaming #games #strategy
